summary: Iteration 7: Full backend + frontend testing of admin space, moderation queues (avis, temoignages, collaborations, enquetes) and public submission pages. Backend: 44/44 pytest passing (added 10 new tests covering admin token auth, admin story CRUD end-to-end with public visibility, review/temoignage moderation pending→approve, collaboration + enquete moderation with all 3 actions approve/refuse/processed, and confirmation that public GET /api/reviews and /api/temoignages only return published=true items). Frontend: verified /avis, /temoignages, /collaborer flows — forms submit, toasts show correct French moderation message, forms clear, and pending submissions do NOT appear in the public list. Admin: wrong token remains on login screen; correct token opens 5-tab dashboard. Story CRUD (create → visible with data-testid admin-story-{id}, edit prefill title, delete confirm removes item) verified. Approving a review from admin makes it appear on /avis. Approving a temoignage makes it appear on /temoignages with 'Témoignage personnel' badge. Collabs & enquetes tabs show Approuver / Marquer traité / Refuser / Supprimer buttons on each item. Regression pages (/, /voyage, /frise, /origine, /livre-du-soir, /univers/lieux-hantes) all render footer with links to /avis /temoignages /collaborer. Test data cleaned up from MongoDB post-run.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx pendingReviews/pendingTemoignages filter uses operator precedence 'a || b && c' — works by chance but should be parenthesised for clarity (r.status === 'pending' || (r.published === false && r.status !== 'refused')).
AdminPage.jsx is 442 lines and holds three inner components (ModerationList, ContactList, Field). Consider splitting into /components/admin/* for maintainability.

server.py PATCH /admin/collaborations and /admin/enquetes accept 'payload: dict' rather than a Pydantic model — trades validation for flexibility; acceptable but a CollabModerateIn model would be safer.
POST /api/reviews returns {received, message} but has no strong email/spam protection — consider rate-limit per IP for public endpoints since anyone can flood the moderation queue.
seed_data_creation: None (test rows created during runs were cleaned up post-execution).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend catalog still 62 base stories / 12 universes. New collections: reviews, temoignages, collaborations, enquetes, user_stories. All admin routes require Bearer chroniques-etrange-2026 (ADMIN_TOKEN in backend/.env). Public GET endpoints only return published=true items. Frontend testids: admin-login, admin-token-input, admin-login-btn, admin-page, admin-tab-{chroniques|avis|temoignages|collabs|enquetes}, admin-story-form, story-title/status/content/save, admin-story-{id}, avis-form, avis-name/comment/submit, avis-star-{1..5}, temoignage-form, temoignage-name/location/title/story/submit, tab-collab/tab-enquete, collab-{name,email,kind,project,message,submit}, enquete-{name,email,place,tradition,submit}, mod-item-{id}/mod-approve-{id}/mod-refuse-{id}/mod-edit-{id}/mod-delete-{id}, contact-{id}. To cleanup TEST_ data, delete rows in collections matching regex ^TEST across name/title/comment/story/message/tradition_summary/project fields.
